title: Fourth Fourier moment and additive energy
statement: For any function $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, the sum of the fourth powers of its vector Fourier coefficients equals $\mathbb{E}_{x,y,z}[f(x)f(y)f(z)f(x+y+z)]$, where $x,y,z$ are independent uniform points of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$.
